title: Totem of Phosphor
description: Changes boring totem of undying to a godly creature Phosphor Slime from Slime Rancher
body:
# Overview
This resoursepack does exactly what you'd expect, it changes model of totem of undying to a Phosphor Slime. Also it looks funny if you _somehow_ put it on your head.![Phosphor slime showcase (in both hands, inventory and in item frame)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eea1bc68d8823c8b8a2628f2d36eeb096c875fc6.png)
